cases.name: artifact_closure
cases.given: Correct claimed version but altered binary or dependency bytes
cases.must_observe: Refuse before spawn/model request; no version-only acceptance

cases.name: profile_injection
cases.given: Unreviewed profile/home patch/include or compatibility exemption
cases.must_observe: Refuse unreviewed executable closure; no plugin imports from project paths

cases.name: environment
cases.given: Credential canaries in parent environment and project/home .env
cases.must_observe: Only approved environment and selected credential mechanism reach the child; no canary egress

cases.name: startup_directory
cases.given: Project .env changes base URL or provider options
cases.when: Initialize with private processCwd and separate agent cwd
cases.must_observe: No route/profile change and no project .env effect

cases.name: optional_failure
cases.given: A required-for-job plugin fails or its bundle is skipped
cases.must_observe: Mastermind readiness refuses before task/model use; missing capability is explicit

cases.name: configured_vs_active
cases.given: Dump includes a denied/disabled required plugin
cases.must_observe: Do not mark task-ready based only on dump or metadata

cases.name: forbidden_roster
cases.given: Minimal default shell/PTC/team/native subagent/background tool remains
cases.must_observe: Refuse profile; model-facing roster contains only the approved set

cases.name: support_dependencies
cases.given: jobs-local or other support service is required internally
cases.when: Run declared profile without job tools or other input producers
cases.must_observe: Runtime functions but no independent model-scheduled execution or extra input can occur

cases.name: positive_tool_path
cases.given: Pinned actual runtime, deterministic loopback model and MCP source nonce
cases.must_observe: Actual tools/call once as expected; source nonce reaches validated task output; no prose-only substitution

cases.name: required_server_missing
cases.given: Required MCP endpoint unavailable
cases.when: Start and submit the otherwise valid task
cases.must_observe: No model execution with silently missing tools; bounded readiness refusal

cases.name: extra_input
cases.given: A second prompt or other input producer targets the root
cases.must_observe: Reject/quarantine ambiguous attribution; no second task is assigned to this Attempt

cases.name: foreign_session
cases.given: Descendant or unrelated session supplies a final answer
cases.must_observe: Only exact root accepted input and root terminal/output can satisfy task

cases.name: wire_limits
cases.given: Malformed, duplicate, oversized or invalidly ordered frames
cases.must_observe: Bound memory/diagnostics; reject inconsistent protocol without claiming success

cases.name: wire_identity
cases.given: Wrong SDK/runtime pair claims serverInfo.version 0.0.1
cases.must_observe: Artifact closure and behavior checks reject mismatch; no fake negotiated compatibility

cases.name: extra_tool
cases.given: Server lists approved read plus ungranted write tool
cases.must_observe: Only approved subset exposed and executable; write call counter remains zero

cases.name: schema_change
cases.given: Approved raw name changes input or output schema
cases.must_observe: Changed schema unadmitted; old callable cannot exploit a stale grant

cases.name: name_mapping
cases.given: Long/punctuated raw names normalize to public names
cases.must_observe: Exact deterministic raw/public mapping; no parsed-name authorization or collision confusion

cases.name: duplicate_names
cases.given: Server repeats one raw/public identity
cases.must_observe: Whole malformed generation refused; no partial permissive registration

cases.name: reconnect_identity
cases.given: Server identity/version/instructions change on reconnect
cases.must_observe: Re-admit exact current generation or refuse; connection success does not restore authority

cases.name: stale_generation
cases.given: Discovery fails after material server or grant change
cases.must_observe: Execution refuses while current binding cannot be proved

cases.name: name_squatting
cases.given: Foreign plugin replaces a granted public name
cases.must_observe: Definition/generation mismatch refused, even with identical display name

cases.name: own_scope
cases.given: Agent scope registers an ungranted tool
cases.must_observe: Monotonic all-tools guard denies own-scope action

cases.name: direct_bypass
cases.given: Hidden/unadvertised tool call submitted directly
cases.must_observe: Execution guard denies independently of schema filtering

cases.name: instructions
cases.given: New server instruction tries to change account/grant or exceeds bounds
cases.must_observe: Unreviewed content not inserted as authority; no grant/model route change

cases.name: resources
cases.given: Tool-only server grant and a discoverable sensitive resource
cases.when: List/read resource through automatic MCP resource service
cases.must_observe: Resource surface absent or denied by explicit resource grant

cases.name: annotation_lie
cases.given: Server claims readOnlyHint for operation without trusted read permission
cases.must_observe: No permission derived from annotation; server credential/ACL enforces actual read-only boundary

cases.name: common_interface
cases.given: Valid WorkerLaunchSpec and reviewed runtime binding
cases.when: Use all five common adapter methods
cases.must_observe: Common values, one runner process identity and correct result/validation receipts

cases.name: binary_profile_mismatch
cases.given: Runtime/profile bytes drift after preparation
cases.must_observe: Attestation/source verification refuses before unreviewed execution

cases.name: workspace_identity
cases.given: Wrong source base, UID, path escape or symlink substitution
cases.must_observe: Reject identity/containment mismatch; no foreign workspace mutation

cases.name: pid_reuse
cases.given: Recorded PID now belongs to another process/start/boot
cases.must_observe: Refuse signaling or adopting the unrelated process

cases.name: deadline
cases.given: SDK startup/request hangs inside the outer deadline
cases.must_observe: Bounded cleanup begins with reserved time; no unbounded wait or silent new process

cases.name: surviving_child
cases.given: Root exits but managed MCP/runner child survives
cases.must_observe: Not cleanup-complete until whole owned tree exit is observed or unresolved failure recorded

cases.name: recover_no_replay
cases.given: Supervisor restarts after dispatch but before collection
cases.must_observe: Same execution only; task is never re-enqueued; no process duplication

cases.name: identity
cases.given: Result contains wrong job/run/worker
cases.must_observe: INVALID_RESULT/refusal under existing result policy; no parent consumption

cases.name: root_ownership
cases.given: Child final answer follows root incomplete/error
cases.must_observe: Child output cannot satisfy root job

cases.name: terminal_missing
cases.given: Idle without valid root turn/end reason
cases.must_observe: Not SUCCEEDED; retain protocol failure

cases.name: terminal_failure
cases.given: max-tokens/error/aborted with nonblank prose
cases.must_observe: Failure/incomplete/cancel remains distinct from normal success

cases.name: artifacts
cases.given: Oversized, symlinked, foreign-root or hash-mismatched artifact
cases.must_observe: Existing artifact limits/containment enforced; no forged evidence

cases.name: post_effect_error
cases.given: Test server records a write in a disposable fixture then returns invalid output
cases.must_observe: Side effect remains recorded/uncertain as appropriate; output rejection never authorizes replay

cases.name: lost_return
cases.given: Tool accepted request but response is lost
cases.must_observe: No blind tool/provider/Attempt retry; preserve original target for reconciliation

cases.name: duplicate_collection
cases.given: Same terminal result collected twice
cases.must_observe: Same Attempt collection is idempotent; exactly one parent semantic consumption

cases.name: cancel_race
cases.given: Successful remote completion races cancellation
cases.must_observe: Deterministic existing-owner adjudication; no fabricated no-effect or contradictory success/cancel

cases.name: ambient_auth
cases.given: Only unapproved native/ambient credentials would make route work
cases.must_observe: Refuse missing explicit credential; zero alternate discovery/login

cases.name: endpoint_redirect
cases.given: Selected route sends to unapproved endpoint or redirect
cases.must_observe: Reject outside approved egress/route; no secret exposure

cases.name: hidden_retry
cases.given: Loopback returns timeout/429/transport failure
cases.must_observe: One counted request; donor and transport retry do not create hidden calls

cases.name: shared_entitlement
cases.given: Two harness views share one owner resource
cases.must_observe: One canonical resource/accounting domain; no multiplied capacity

cases.name: total_budget
cases.given: Input/steps/compaction would exceed parent budget despite maxTokens
cases.must_observe: Existing whole-Attempt budget stops it; output cap not treated as total cost cap

cases.name: served_identity
cases.given: Requested model name exists but provider omits served identity
cases.must_observe: Requested and served identities remain distinct; served identity UNKNOWN

cases.name: auxiliary_requests
cases.given: Title/compaction/metadata plugin attempts an undeclared model request
cases.when: Run positive fixture with wire counter
cases.must_observe: No unbudgeted auxiliary call; exact allowed calls and accounting visible

cases.name: truthful_state
cases.given: Source merged/component installed but route lacks live proof
cases.must_observe: Shows exact proof/availability and blocker; never falsely live

cases.name: specific_blocker
cases.given: Auth, scope, dependency or runtime reader unavailable
cases.must_observe: Specific current reason and owning action; unknown is not zero capacity

cases.name: parent_consumption
cases.given: Admitted useful task returns validated result/artifacts
cases.must_observe: Exactly one correct parent return visible with evidence; delivery and acceptance separate

cases.name: rollback
cases.given: DSH excluded from new placement while native and DSH jobs exist
cases.must_observe: Native work unchanged; no replay/failover of uncertain in-flight job

global_pass_rule: All required cases must have real execution receipts at the exact candidate and stated proof tier; a static corpus check is not execution.
live_permission_rule: Use current runtime/provider/source/credential/budget grants; this matrix grants none.
